note: Evidence feeds' own page, on the tour's two months (ADR 0026 §6): the tour's story (examples/larkspur/tour.json) as far as it is about this flow's files. The same files sent again, the same decisions at the same times, each by the flow's owner; HR's file and its decision are HR organisation's, and not here. The WAF's band, said on Fri Mar 22 for Mon Mar 25, is this flow's too, and the log pipelines' migration is written down as going on; the catalogue's new control is the estate's, and not here. Wed Mar 27 is left to decide, as it is in the tour.

changes.why: The control board's standard holds a day when more than a tenth of a WAF's applications fail. The band of 0 to 15% was looser than that: a tenth, from Monday

note.saw: A WAF fails 2 to 4% of its applications on a usual day, and the band let up to 15% pass
note.chose: Hold the day when more than a tenth fail, as the board's standard says
note.turnedDown: Keeping 15%: a WAF could fail one application in seven before anyone was asked
note.expect: No hold in a usual quarter
